prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Draw a square reaction sticker of a plump custard-yellow kitten laughing so hard its whole body shakes. Give it a huge round head, two tiny triangular ears, a cream belly, stubby paws, and a short curled tail. Show it front-on, leaning back slightly with both forepaws pressed to its belly. Squeeze its eyes shut into upward crescents, puff out its cheeks, and make its wide-open laughing mouth the center of the image, with a dark interior, one broad white upper tooth, and a pink tongue. Add a tiny tear of laughter at each outer eye corner. Render it like a soft, rounded 3D cartoon toy with smooth surfaces, warm yellow shading, and an exaggerated, goofy expression. Center the full body on a plain white background with a faint ground shadow. No text, props, or border.
